**Mundra** is a **port in Gujarat, India**, on the **northern shores of the Gulf of Kutch**. It is widely described as India’s **largest commercial port** and also India’s **largest private port**.[2][3][4]

If you meant the *UN/LOCODE* or port code, Mundra’s code is **INMUN**.[5]
